title: Geometry-Dependent Approximation and Stability Properties of Shallow ReLU$^k$ Networks on Bounded Euclidean Domains
abstract: arXiv:2611.13952v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On bounded Euclidean domains, we study how hidden-parameter geometry affects shallow ReLU$^k$ networks through results on approximation rates, saturation-type lower bounds, Gram and stiffness matrix spectra, Bernstein and Marcinkiewicz--Zygmund inequalities, discrete least-squares recovery, and inverse approximation.   Our analysis uses smooth localization and dyadic Fourier estimates. We quantify parameter geometry by the fill distance $h$ and antipodal separation distance $\underline h$. translated_title: 有界欧几里得域上浅层ReLU$^k$网络的几何依赖逼近与稳定性性质
translated_abstract: 在有界欧几里得域上，我们通过逼近速率、饱和型下界、Gram矩阵与刚度矩阵的谱、Bernstein不等式与Marcinkiewicz-Zygmund不等式、离散最小二乘恢复以及逆逼近等结果，研究隐藏参数几何如何影响浅层ReLU$^k$网络。我们的分析采用光滑局部化技术和二进傅里叶估计。我们用填充距离 $h$ 和对径分离距离 $\underline h$ 来量化参数几何。对于给定的网络空间 $L_n^k$，代表性的逼近估计形式为：上界 $\inf_{g_n\in L_n^k}\|f-g_n\|_{\mathcal L^2(\Omega')}\lesssim h^r\|f\|_{\mathcal H^r(\Omega)}$ 利用目标函数直至临界阶数 $\frac{d+2...}$ 的正则性（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文揭示了有界欧氏域上浅层ReLU$^k$网络的逼近精度与稳定性由隐藏参数几何（填充距离与对径分离距离）定量决定，并给出了逼近上界、饱和型下界以及矩阵谱和最小二乘恢复等系统的稳定性分析。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that the approximation accuracy and stability of shallow ReLU$^k$ networks on bounded Euclidean domains are quantitatively governed by hidden-parameter geometry (fill distance and antipodal separation distance), providing approximation upper bounds, saturation-type lower bounds, and systematic stability analyses of matrix spectra and least-squares recovery.
